description: An unknown list of one or two strings converted to a set isn't equal to an empty set
notes: The spec says a comparison with an unknown operand gives an unknown bool. ConditionalExpr.Value (hclsyntax/expression.go) refines the unknown choice between the two lists with the range of their lengths, one to two, go-cty keeps a lower bound of one when it converts the unknown list to a set, because merging equal elements can't empty a set (prepareUnknownResult in cty/convert/conversion.go), and Value.Equals (cty/value_ops.go) uses it to rule out an empty set.
